Q1 (h14): Each memo carries derived metadata computed from its content rather than set by the user, used for lists/previews (look for memo Payload / property / snippet — grep for 'Payload', 'Property', 'Snippet', 'RebuildMemoPayload' or similar in store/ and server/). Cite each enforcement site with path:line and a one-line description.

- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Teaches a design-system-agnostic method: a form heuristic, a color formula with a runnable validator, mark specs, and interaction rules. A validated default palette is documented in `references/palette.md` — swap that file's values for your brand's. - update-config: Use this skill to configure the Claude Code harness via settings.json. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". - simplify: Review the changed code for reuse, simplification, efficiency, and altitude cleanups, then apply the fixes. Quality only — it does not hunt for bugs; use /code-review for that.
- fewer-permission-prompts: Scan your transcripts for common read-only Bash and MCP tool calls, then add a prioritized allowlist to project .claude/settings.json to reduce permission prompts.
- loop: Run a prompt or slash command on a recurring interval (e.g. /loop 5m /foo, defaults to 10m) - When the user wants to set up a recurring task, poll for status, or run something repeatedly on an interval (e.g. "check the deploy every 5 minutes", "keep running /babysit-prs"). content.text:
Findings below.

---

# Q1 — Derived memo metadata (MemoPayload)

## Computation site

**`/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:74-88`** — `RebuildMemoPayload(ctx, memo *store.Memo, markdownService markdown.Service)`. It allocates `memo.Payload` if nil (line 75-77), calls `markdownService.ExtractAll([]byte(memo.Content))` (line 80), then assigns:
- `memo.Payload.Tags = data.Tags` (line 85)
- `memo.Payload.Property = data.Property` (line 86)

Note it only overwrites `Tags` and `Property`; `Payload.Location` (user-supplied) is preserved.

The actual markdown parse/extraction is **`/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:356-422`** — `(*service).ExtractAll`, a single goldmark AST walk:

| Property | Line | Extraction |
|---|---|---|
| Tags | `markdown.go:376-378` | `asMemoTagNode(n)` → append `tagNode.Tag` |
| Mentions | `markdown.go:379-381` | `*mast.MentionNode` → lowercased username (used for notifications, NOT stored in payload) |
| `Property.Title` | `markdown.go:383-389` | first block child of document that is an H1 `gast.Heading` → `extractHeadingText` |
| `Property.HasLink` | `markdown.go:393-394` | `gast.KindLink` |
| `Property.HasCode` | `markdown.go:396-397` | `gast.KindCodeBlock, KindFencedCodeBlock, KindCodeSpan` |
| `Property.HasTaskList` | `markdown.go:399-400` | `east.KindTaskCheckBox` |
| `Property.HasIncompleteTasks` | `markdown.go:401-405` | `*east.TaskCheckBox` with `!checkBox.IsChecked` |
| Tag dedup | `markdown.go:418-419` | `uniquePreserveCase` on tags and mentions |

Standalone (older/alternate) variants of the same logic: `ExtractProperties` at `markdown.go:193-241` (same switch at 215-231) and `ExtractTags` at `markdown.go:~140-170`. Only `ExtractAll` is used by `RebuildMemoPayload`.

Schema: **`/bench/repo/proto/store/memo.proto:7-29`** — `MemoPayload{ Property property=1; Location location=2; repeated string tags=3 }`, `Property{ has_link, has_task_list, has_code, has_incomplete_tasks, title }`. Note: there is **no** `references` field and the snippet is **not** stored in the payload.

## Triggers for recomputation

1. **CreateMemo** — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:108` (inside `CreateMemo`, declared at `memo_service.go:70`), called after the content-length check and before `s.Store.CreateMemo`. Location is layered on afterwards at `memo_service.go:112` (`create.Payload.Location = convertLocationToStore(...)`).
2. **UpdateMemo, `content` field mask path** — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:447` (inside `UpdateMemo`, declared at `memo_service.go:401`); result written into the update at `memo_service.go:450-451` (`update.Content`, `update.Payload`). Payload is **only** rebuilt when `"content"` is in the update mask; the `"location"` path at `memo_service.go:481-484` mutates `memo.Payload.Location` without re-parsing.
3. **CreateMemoComment** — indirectly, via `s.CreateMemo(...)` at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:55-58`.
4. **Backfill runner** — `/bench/repo/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go:27-72` `RunOnce` rebuilds payloads for all memos in batches of 100 and persists via `store.UpdateMemo` (line 56-59). Note: `memopayload.NewRunner` / `RunOnce` have **no callers anywhere in the repo** (`/bench/repo/server/server.go:162-163` only wires `s3presign.NewRunner`), so this backfill path is currently dead code.

Persistence of the JSON payload column: `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo.go:184,218`, `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/memo.go:178,225`, `/bench/repo/store/db/mysql/memo.go:193,240`.

## Snippet (computed on read, not stored)

- **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:83-90`** — `getMemoContentSnippet` → `MarkdownService.GenerateSnippet(content, 64)`.
- Implementation: **`/bench/repo/internal/markdown/markdown.go:264-346`** — AST walk that skips fenced/indented code blocks (line 277-278), inserts spaces between block elements (285-291), emits text/autolink URL/`#tag` (309-320), stops at `maxLength*2` (327-329), truncates at word boundary (341-343).
- Read-path call sites: `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:76-80` (every converted memo), `:225` and `:248` (relation snippets), `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:154,162`, `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:318-323`.

## Payload consumers

- API conversion: `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:47-50` and `convertMemoPropertyFromStore` at `:315-327`.
- User stats aggregation: `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:138-152` and `:254-268`.
- Store-side filtering on payload JSON: `/bench/repo/store/memo.go:84-91` (`FindMemoPayload{Raw, HasTaskList, HasLink, HasCode, HasIncompleteTasks}`).

---

# Q2 — Visibility enforcement sites

## Core gRPC/Connect API

1. **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:39-68`** — `checkMemoReadAccess`, the canonical single-memo gate: archived → creator only (`:45-53`); `Visibility != Public` requires an authenticated user (`:55-61`); `Private` requires `memo.CreatorID == user.ID` (`:63-65`). Note it does **not** grant admins access to others' private memos (unlike other sites).
   - Called from **`memo_service.go:356`** (GetMemo), **`memo_service.go:367`** (parent memo of a comment in GetMemo), **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:148`** (ListMemoComments).
2. **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:218-227`** — ListMemos default visibility restriction: anonymous → `VisibilityList = [PUBLIC]`; authenticated → CEL filter `creator_id == N || visibility in ["PUBLIC","PROTECTED"]`; other-creator listing → `[PUBLIC, PROTECTED]`. Archived listing is forced to `CreatorID = currentUser.ID` at `memo_service.go:190-196`.
3. **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:41-43`** — CreateMemoComment: rejects commenting on a `Private` memo you don't own (non-superuser); comment visibility is then forced to the parent's at `:47`.
4. **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go:155-160`** — ListMemoComments applies the `visibility in ["PUBLIC","PROTECTED"]` CEL `MemoFilter` to the relation query (`:174-181`) so private comments of other users are excluded.
5. **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go:103-131`** — ListMemoRelations: builds `memoFilter` (`visibility == "PUBLIC"` anonymous / `creator_id == N || visibility in [...]` authed) and passes it as `MemoFilter` to both the outgoing (`:115-118`) and incoming (`:128-131`) relation queries.
6. **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_converter.go:177-207`** — `batchConvertMemoRelations` applies the same `memoFilter` to batch relation loads (`:196-198`, `:203-206`); this is the gate behind `loadMemoRelations` (`:285-291`) used by GetMemo/ListMemos/CreateMemoComment.
7. **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go:213-225`** — ListMemoAttachments: `Visibility != Public` → auth required; `Private` → creator or superuser only.
8. **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/attachment_service.go:436-454`** — `checkAttachmentAccess` (used by `GetAttachment` at `attachment_service.go:256`): resolves the linked memo and returns early if `Public` (`:445`), else requires auth (`:447`) and blocks `Private` for non-creator/non-superuser (`:451`).
9. **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:29-40`** — ListMemoReactions: `Visibility != Public` → auth required; `Private` → creator/superuser only.
10. **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/reaction_service.go:82-85`** — UpsertMemoReaction: blocks reacting to another user's `Private` memo.
11. **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:83-92`** — ListAllUserStats visibility scoping (anonymous → `[PUBLIC]`, else CEL creator-or-public/protected filter).
12. **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_stats.go:217-221`** — GetUserStats: anonymous → `[PUBLIC]`, other user → `[PUBLIC, PROTECTED]`.

## HTTP file router (attachment binary serving)

13. **`/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:650-703`** — `checkAttachmentPermission`, invoked from `serveAttachmentFile` at `fileserver.go:149` (route `/file/attachments/:uid/:filename`, registered `:123`). Unlinked attachment → creator/admin only (`:652-664`); `Public` + `s.Profile.AllowAnonymous()` → allow (`:677-679`); valid non-expired `share_token` matching this memo → allow (`:684-689`); otherwise auth required (`:691-697`) and `Private` blocked for non-creator/non-admin (`:699-701`).

## Share tokens (deliberate bypass)

14. **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_share_service.go:153-191`** — `GetMemoByShare` is an unauthenticated endpoint (allow-listed in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/acl_config.go:40-41`) that returns any memo regardless of visibility once the share token resolves; the only gates are token validity/expiry (`getActiveMemoShare` at `:199`, `isMemoShareExpired` at `:195-197`) and archived state (`:163-166`).

## Realtime / SSE

15. **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go:133-144`** — `(*SSEClient).canReceive`: `store.Private` events only delivered to `c.userID == event.CreatorID` or `store.RoleAdmin`; `Public`/`Protected`/unset delivered to everyone (including anonymous subscribers); unknown visibility denied. Event visibility is stamped in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/sse_event_helpers.go:29-37` and `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go:75`.

## Notifications / email

16. **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_notifications.go:302-316`** — `canViewerAccessMemo` (Private → creator only unless superuser; Protected → any authenticated viewer); enforced when converting inbox notifications at `:337`, `:342`, `:370`, `:385`.
17. **`/bench/repo/server/notification/email.go:306-320`** — duplicate `canViewerAccessMemo` for the email dispatcher, enforced at `email.go:155` (comment email: both comment and parent memo) and `email.go:187` (mention email).
18. **`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_mention_helpers.go:56-72`** — `canUserAccessMentionContext`: suppresses mention inbox/notification when the memo (or its parent) is `Private` and the mentioned user isn't the creator; used at `:88` in `shouldSkipMentionInbox`.

## Anonymous/public surfaces hard-scoped to PUBLIC

19. **`/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go:90`** (instance RSS) and **`/bench/repo/server/router/rss/rss.go:141`** (per-user RSS) — `VisibilityList: []store.Visibility{store.Public}`.
20. **`/bench/repo/server/router/frontend/frontend.go:150`** — sitemap.xml lists only `store.Public` memos.

## Store layer (where the filters become SQL)

21. `FindMemo.VisibilityList` → `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo.go:96-103`, `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/memo.go:89`, `/bench/repo/store/db/mysql/memo.go:104`.
22. `FindMemoRelation.MemoFilter` (the CEL visibility predicate) compiled into `memo_id IN (SELECT id FROM memo WHERE ...)` **and** `related_memo_id IN (...)` → `/bench/repo/store/db/sqlite/memo_relation.go:80-93`, `/bench/repo/store/db/postgres/memo_relation.go:82-105`, `/bench/repo/store/db/mysql/memo_relation.go:73-…`.

## Notes / gaps worth flagging

- The ACL allow-list `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/acl_config.go:32-41` marks `GetMemo`, `ListMemos`, `ListMemoComments`, `GetLinkMetadata`, `BatchGetLinkMetadata`, `GetMemoByShare` as anonymous-reachable, explicitly deferring to service-layer visibility checks (comment at `:32`).
- **Link preview does no memo-visibility check at all**: `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_link_metadata.go:14-38` fetches arbitrary URLs for unauthenticated callers with no memo context.
- Inconsistent superuser handling: `checkMemoReadAccess` (`memo_service.go:63`) omits the `!isSuperUser(user)` escape hatch that `memo_attachment_service.go:222`, `attachment_service.go:451`, `reaction_service.go:38,83`, and `fileserver.go:699` all include.
- `batchConvertMemoRelations` filters *relations* by visibility but the follow-up memo fetch at `memo_service_converter.go:240-244` (`store.FindMemo{IDList: extraIDs}`) has no visibility filter — it only resolves UID/snippet for IDs already surviving the relation filter, so the filter is load-bearing there.
